trails.name: Fairway & Morgan House Loop
trails.story: The gentle opener. From the roundabout to the ivy-walled Morgan House, then along the rough at the edge of the golf fairways with the Kanchenjunga side open to the north, and home past Tashiding.
highlights: Open fairway crest, best mountain sightline on the ridge
trails.caution: The fairway section is active golf ground. Walk the east rough and clear timings with the club.
trails.best: Early morning, October to April, for the snow view.

trails.name: Durpin Crown Circuit
trails.theme: Summit, monastery and the big view
trails.story: A short crown walk around the summit. Reach the gold-roofed monastery, step out to the helipad rim, then drop a few metres onto the grass shoulder where footpaths already show in the turf and the Teesta and Relli valleys fall away below.
trails.caution: Helipad and parade ground are working areas. Keep to the rim.
trails.best: Sunrise or the last hour before sunset.

trails.name: South Face Meadow Balcony
trails.story: The signature new trail. Below the monastery the whole south face is sunlit grass with scattered trees. This line contours across it like a balcony, 60 to 100 m below the crest, to a meadow knoll, then meets the lower road at the hairpins.
highlights: Unbroken valley view the whole way
No tree cutting needed, the line stays in the open
trails.caution: Scout line, not yet a path. Steep grass, slippery when wet. Needs benching and a few steps before guests walk it.
trails.best: November to March, dry grass and clear air.

trails.name: Line Dara Spur
trails.theme: Ridge spur to a river viewpoint
trails.story: Out along the south-west spur to Line Dara, the mapped viewpoint that hangs over the great bend of the Teesta. Return across the west meadow shelf so that no ground is walked twice.
highlights: Line Dara, the widest Teesta view in the area
Spur-crest walking with drops on both sides
trails.caution: Spur line is a scout line through mixed grass and forest. Confirm the ridge is passable before fixing it.

trails.name: West Glade & Clearing Trail
trails.story: West off the ridge onto broad grass terraces, then into the trees to a levelled forest clearing. A dirt track that is plain on the imagery, but absent from the map, leads down from it and closes the loop.
highlights: Forest clearing, a natural picnic and briefing spot
trails.caution: First half is a scout line across the terraces. The track section is seen on imagery only.

trails.name: Orange Farm & East Shoulder Loop
trails.story: East from the ridge to the Orange Farm viewpoint, out along the unsealed road across the open east shoulder, then through the terraced lanes of Upper Bong and straight up the village slope to Morgan House.
highlights: Open east slope with the Relli valley below
trails.caution: The climb from Upper Bong to the ridge is drawn as a scout line through the village. Lanes and steps certainly exist there, follow the local ones.
trails.best: December for oranges on the trees.

trails.name: South Hamlet Meadow Circuit
trails.story: Down the winding road to the hamlet on the south slope, then a climbing scout line back up through forest edge and open meadow to arrive under the monastery from below, the way the hill was first approached.
highlights: Quiet hamlet at the road end
Monastery appearing above on the climb
trails.caution: The return climb is a scout line of about 150 m ascent. Local villagers almost certainly use a path here, ask and follow theirs.

trails.name: Ridge to River: Relli Descent
trails.story: The long day. Leave the ridge at 1,370 m, cross the open east shoulder, and drop through forest to the footbridge on the Relli Khola at about 320 m. Lunch on the boulders, then cross the bridge to the valley road for the vehicle home.
highlights: Over 1,000 m of descent through three vegetation bands
Relli Khola boulder beach and footbridge
trails.caution: Expedition grade. Both lower sections are scout lines on very steep forested ground, the last one averages about 50 percent slope. Needs a proper recce, a local guide and a vehicle waiting at the Relli road.
trails.best: October to March. Avoid monsoon, the river rises fast.

trails.name: Tagore's Trail
trails.story: North along the ridge past Morgan House to the abandoned bungalows and on to Gouripur House, where Tagore stayed and read a poem over the telephone for All India Radio. Return through the garden belt of Atisha Road.
trails.caution: Mapped lanes and stairs throughout. Gouripur House is fragile, view from outside.

trails.name: Stairway City Heritage Walk
trails.story: Kalimpong's old town is stitched together by stone stairways, and this walk uses the mapped flights to reach the Lepcha Museum and finish at Mangal Dham, where a vehicle collects the group.
highlights: Mapped stair flights between the lanes
trails.caution: One way, arrange a pick-up. Many steps. Town traffic at road crossings.

trails.name: W&T West Forest Loop
trails.story: Down the grass terraces and across the forested west face to the W&T viewpoint on its own spur, then back by the quiet west road and the hairpins.
highlights: Dense west-face forest, the best birding leg
trails.caution: The forest crossing from the terraces to W&T is a scout line. Long descent out, long climb home.
trails.best: Morning, the west face is shaded.

trails.name: Gandhi Ashram & 7th Mile Traverse
trails.story: A one-way traverse of the whole west face by Gandhi Ashram School and the 6th Mile church, finishing at the 7th Mile viewpoint above the Teesta gorge where a vehicle collects the group.
highlights: Gandhi Ashram School, where every pupil learns the violin
Finishes on the main road for pick-up
trails.caution: One way, arrange a pick-up. Final stretch shares the highway verge.
trails.best: Afternoon, for the light in the gorge.

trails.name: Grand Durpin Skyline
trails.story: Everything in one day: the west terraces and clearing, Line Dara, the whole South Face balcony from west to east, the monastery reached from below, the east shoulder orchards, Morgan House and a finish along the fairways.
highlights: Links six of the shorter circuits
All three landscapes: ridge, forest, meadow
trails.caution: Long. Includes the scout sections of trails 3, 4, 5 and 6, so it opens only after those are proven.
trails.best: A clear winter day, start by 7 am.
